description.value: The Cambie is one of Vancouver's oldest continuously operating bars, established in 1897 in the aftermath of the Great Vancouver Fire and a fixture in downtown Vancouver ever since. The venue runs as a full bar and grill with a patio, regular live music nights, karaoke, and a wide rotating selection of BC craft beer on tap. An associated Cambie Hostel operates on the same property, making it a natural waypoint for budget-conscious touring cyclists passing through the city.
